name: The Shala Dubai
reason: Too thin and no clear contact route: its own site (theshaladubai.com, Squarespace; robots.txt allows us) has one current item, the membership prices page (1-month pass AED 1,150, drop-in AED 125); its only workshop (5 April) has passed, the courses and guest-teacher pages are empty placeholders, and the book club page is a reading list. No email is published and the only form is a sign-up block on the home page, not a contact form. Classes run inside the Zoga Yoga Cafe venues (Downtown and Dubai Internet City). Possible future listing: Nathalie Daou (SYC Level 2).
